sections.0.items.2.text: 最後更新：2026 年 11 月（草稿）
sections.0.items.3.text: 綠島的船班和海上活動常受天候影響。這一頁說明取消、改期和退款怎麼處理。
Ferries and sea activities on Green Island are often affected by the weather. This page explains how cancellations, date changes and refunds work.
sections.1.items.0.text: 1  Weather, ferry cancellations and force majeure
sections.1.items.1.text:
・出發前遇到颱風、海象不佳、船班停航，或主管機關公告停止活動，我們會主動聯絡你。你可以選擇免費改期，或退款。
・行程中因天候停航或無法下水，未進行的部分可以改期或退款。
・已代購且無法退回的費用（例如已出票的船票），會先扣除。
・回程船班停航、需要延長住宿時，每天的住宿有半價優惠。

・If a typhoon, rough seas, a ferry cancellation or an official suspension affects your trip before departure, we will contact you. You can choose a free date change or a refund.
・If weather stops the ferry or diving during your trip, the parts not carried out can be rescheduled or refunded.
・Non-refundable costs already paid on your behalf (such as issued ferry tickets) will be deducted first.
・If your return ferry is cancelled and you need to stay longer, extra nights are half price.

sections.3.items.6.text: 改期：出發前請盡早聯絡我們，依船班和名額安排。
Date changes: please contact us as early as possible before departure; we'll arrange it based on ferries and availability.
sections.4.items.0.text: 4  Unable to dive for personal reasons
sections.4.items.1.text: 因身體狀況、健康問卷未通過或未遵守安全規定而無法下水，屬於旅客自身因素，依第 3 項處理；已使用的住宿和交通費用不退。

If you can't dive because of your physical condition, not passing the medical questionnaire or not following safety rules, this is a personal reason and is handled under item 3; accommodation and transport already used are non-refundable.
